text: dhammassānudhammaṃ na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheṭhesi . nu taṃ samanupassituṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti . no hetaṃ bhante . evaṃ passaṃ bāhiya sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati .pe. yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati . vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti . khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . [119] atha kho āyasmā
